# Influencer outreach

**Recruit real creators for a campaign: fit and fake-follower checks, personal outreach, a disclosed brief and per-creator tracking.**

Finds, vets and contacts creators to promote a product, launch or agent from the brand side — defining the creator profile, building a shortlist by hand, authenticity checks (fake followers, bought views, engagement pods, audience geography), one-by-one personalised outreach with no mass DMs, offers and fair pay, a creator brief with disclosure built in, platform paid-partnership tools, and tracking each creator's results. Use when an operator wants creators to post about their product, app, agent or launch, needs to check whether a creator's audience is real, writes outreach to creators, or runs a seeding or paid creator campaign. Not for being the creator who gets paid (brand-deals-and-sponsorships) or unpaid content swaps (collabs-and-cross-promotion).

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Grow](../README.md) | intermediate | 2–3 h to shortlist and pitch, 2–4 weeks to run | `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Write the creator profile
2. Build a long list by hand (30–50)
3. Score fit and cut to 15
4. Run the authenticity check on each
5. Decide the offer
6. Write each message for one person
7. Agree a written brief
8. Review, post, and check the live post
9. Track and close out per creator

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.
